place._theme: An abandoned camp here, a working dig there. The base's own exclusions at both ends: no caves, no natural sites; a dig crew camps by kit, not in the wild.

prose.name: Supply Run: Dig Site on <SecondPlanet>
prose.briefing: A survey crew moved their dig off <Planet>, and their last supply drop landed at the old camp anyway. Someone should get it to them.

beats.objective: Check the camp beacon at the <Place>
beats.journal: The beacon at the <Place> is still broadcasting the crew's new site: the <SecondPlace> on <SecondPlanet>. Their supplies arrived after they left.
beats.name: Abandoned Camp Beacon
say: To anyone near our old camp. Our last supply drop went to the wrong site. Bring it out to us. We've been living on emergency rations since.

message.title: Supply Crate
message.text: Still sealed. The label has the old camp crossed out, and the new site written underneath in marker, twice, in case the first one was missed.

beats.objective: Deliver the supplies to the <SecondPlace> on <SecondPlanet>
beats.journal: I got the crate out to the <SecondPlace>. The crew had been rationing for a week and had stopped expecting it.
beats.name: Dig Site Stores
say: That's ours. We'd given up on it.
